title: Quintessential Molten Peruvian Chwinamul Tacu Tacu
description: A fatty and molten Peruvian dish featuring chwinamul, perfect for a brunch mood, made diabetic friendly with careful ingredient selection. This dish is a creative take on traditional tacu tacu.

ingredients.name: chwinamul
ingredients.notes: also known as aster scaber, use leaves and stems

ingredients.name: queso fresco
ingredients.notes: crumbly, diabetic friendly alternative to traditional cheese

instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic and aji amarillo pepper into a smooth paste.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the pounded garlic and pepper paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chwinamul, peruvian corn, and beans to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Using a spoon, create 4 wells in the mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Sprinkle the queso fresco over the top of the dish and serve hot.
